label_source: human (IndEgo gold, single labeller, read-only snapshot)
protocol: LOCO over 7 IndEgo clips; L2-normalised window mean of per-frame L2-normalised EG2 embeddings; StandardScaler fit on the train fold; LogisticRegression(C=0.01, class_weight='balanced'). CI and deltas: clip bootstrap B=2000 seed 0, ONE shared resample set for all rows (paired by construction).
sampling: one decode+embed pass at native 10 fps (100 frames/window); 5 fps and 2 fps are exact row subsamples ::2 and ::5 of the same pass

manifest.paths_note: the pristine manifest carries source-machine paths; the pod paths are obtained by remapping '/home/parshu/projects/awing/data/' -> '/workspace/jadal_pod_bundle/data/' in memory only (150/150 resolve)

embedding_caches.git: not committed (large binary); regenerate with eval/exp_fps/embed_dense_eg2.py

pipeline_validation.decode: sequential native frames at index ::5 are pixel-identical to the published per-sample POS_MSEC seek decode (6/6 windows incl. the five 21-frame windows re-checked, max abs diff 0)
pipeline_validation.note: same frames, independent embedding pass: residual is bf16/batching numerics; its AUROC effect is the 2fps_subsample - 2fps_cached row

measured_cost.basis: measured on NVIDIA A40, batch 16: 26.9 frames/s encode, decode 5.2 ms/frame, VRAM peak 2.17 GB

verdict_rule: adopt if a denser row is ESTABLISHED better than the same-pass 2 fps control (paired clip-bootstrap CI excluding 0); drop if one is established worse, or if nothing is established while denser sampling costs strictly more and the best point delta is below the 0.005 practical-significance bar; maybe if mixed; inconclusive otherwise
statistical_read: the density effect is NOT established at any density: every paired CI includes 0, and the 2fps_subsample - 2fps_cached row shows that re-embedding the SAME frames moves the AUROC by a comparable amount
decision: keep the 2 fps EG2 view; do not pay 2.5x/5x the embedding cost for a denser view - no gain is established and the point estimates are inside the pipeline-noise floor
claim_status: no non-inferiority margin was pre-stated; every claim below rests on the paired clip-bootstrap CI over 7 clips (small: wide CIs)
